lens: Dualism in the concepts: which words and structures on the public face are built as two poles with one favoured, or as a standard standing outside what it judges; which pairs are honest distinctions; what the atlas's families would be if named by dynamics alone.
in_one_paragraph: The dualism is in the structure first, and in the words because of it. The atlas sorts 183 dynamics into eight families by how they come out, and five family names are adverse (ending, drains, capture, locks, stagnation), two are neutral, and one is favourable (kept regions, renewal, generation). The entries' own data draws that as a hub: 37 of the 55 exits between families have the favourable family H at one end, and "Capture" has no exit to any other dynamic. So the terrain picture on the home page reads as one place to stay and the ways of falling out of it. The same law is repeatedly cut across the poles: 28 of 245 records sit in more than one family, and one regulation record is filed under loss (A), oscillation (F) and kept regions (H). The pages know this and answer with disclaimers instead of names: every entry carries `"valence": "none asserted"` (183 of 183), every family page says "no entry marks a dynamic good or bad", and across the 60 site pages "good and evil / good or bad" occurs 39 times and "ranks nothing / orders nothing / weighs for no one" 75 times. A reader meets valenced names beside repeated denials of valence, and that reads as defensive. The central words carry it too: "loss" (1,294 uses on the site), "lock" (718), "capture" (551), "drain" (240), "rank" (1,041), "degeneration", "stagnation", "blind", "self-concern" and "the one step" to others, "people and AI" as a formula. For most of these the work already has a neutral statement (draw, reach 及, ends 尽, "a count the loop does not read", "a rule read from the share it selects"), so the fix is mostly choosing the name it already owns. The densest dualism on the home page is the author's own opening of 10 October (cancer, enemies, winners, "the line", "the truth"), which only Ren can move. Several pairs do honest work and should stay: reads/does not reach, within/beyond a renewal, goes on/ends, pass/fail of a frozen test, and the graded "how far seen".

findings.what: The atlas's families are bins by outcome with valence in the names: five adverse, two neutral, one favourable. The plan that defined them already noticed and patched it with a parenthesis.
findings.quote: "A. Absorption and ending", "B. Drains beyond what couples in", "C. Capture of the selection", "D. Locks of knowing", "G. Closure and stagnation", "H. Kept regions, renewal, generation"; plan: "H. Kept regions, renewal, generation (none assumed good)"; G defined as "what can form stops widening"
findings.why_it_matters: These eight names are on the home page inside terrain.svg, so they are the first thing a reader takes as 'the map'. The poles are bad ways to end up against one good way to be, with H favoured. G is defined as the negation of widening and called stagnation, which is the 'widening is better' frame Ren set aside on 10 November, built into the partition.

findings.what: The terrain's topology is a hub around the favoured family. Counted from entries/dynamics.json: 321 exits, 251 lead 'to a state in words', 70 are placed in a dynamic, 55 of those cross families, and 37 of the 55 have H at one end (H to A 8, H to B 6, B to H 9). C (Capture) has 0 exits to any dynamic; E joins the rest by one arrow.

Capture is drawn as a sink with no way on to anything else on the map. A reader cannot see one dynamic turning into another (物极必反, 对立统一) because the nodes are outcomes, not dynamics.

findings.what: One law is cut into a favoured half and an adverse half and filed apart. 28 of 245 records appear in more than one family.
findings.quote: record regulation-from-one-side-and-locally: A "Loss of renewal for good", F "Beyond the gap an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever", H "Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late"; record a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits: A "The ends of a rule rebuilt from its members" and H "A rule rebuilt from the members it limits"
findings.why_it_matters: These records are where the work already has what Ren asks for: one relation whose regimes (holds, cycles, ends) are positions of one parameter. The family partition hides exactly that unity and shows the reader three unrelated entries on three pages.

findings.what: The same formal thing gets a favourable or an adverse name by family. A is "a region not left", C and D are locks, H is "kept regions". H's own entries include locks and endings: 16 of H's 37 mechanisms speak of ends (19 of A's 29), and H holds an entry "locked where closed under revision". The uses page says the models cannot tell the two apart.
findings.where: /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/results/atlas/families/h.md; /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/USES.md (People and AI together, last paragraph); /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/results/atlas/families/c.md (closed-capture, Open)
findings.quote: USES: "telling capture from accountable revision in an actual practice is reading what its shaping changes, which they do not model; and they rank neither"; c.md: "Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes."; H: "Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision"
findings.why_it_matters: 'Lock' against 'kept', and 'capture' against 'accountable revision', are one dynamic named twice by whether the writer likes what is held. The text concedes it in a subordinate clause while the names assert the opposite. Family C also files "A code formed between formations" (how a shared language forms) under Capture.

findings.what: The law that says arising and ceasing condition each other is filed under 'stagnation', and the cost of keeping is filed under 'drains'.
findings.quote: G: "Ceasing needs arising; under a bounded list the two keep pace", "The rest theorem", "Where the possible grows"; B: "What keeping forgoes, and a coupling against it"
findings.why_it_matters: The closest thing the work has to a proved 生灭相待 sits in the family whose name judges rest as failure. What a kept region forgoes is not on the kept family's page. A reader of H never sees what keeping draws on or closes.

findings.what: The atlas asks what a dynamic does beyond its couplings mostly of the families named as bad. The field `beyond` is filled for 22 of B's 26 entries, 7 of H's 37, and none of F's or G's. The schema has no field for what a dynamic draws on, opens, closes, or who bears it.

findings.what: Valence is designed into the schema and then denied in every row and on every page, instead of being absent.
findings.quote: "valence": "none asserted" (183 of 183 entries); "where widening and narrowing are more and less future, not good and evil, so no entry marks a dynamic good or bad"
findings.why_it_matters: A reader sees 'Capture', 'Drains', 'stagnation' as headings and one line later is told nothing is marked good or bad. Across the 60 site pages 'good and evil / good or bad' appears 39 times, 'no should' 33, and 'ranks nothing / orders nothing / weighs for no one' 75. Negating the pair keeps the pair on stage; it reads as a text arguing with its earlier self, which is part of 'does not feel serious'.

findings.what: 'Loss' is the working noun everywhere, though the atlas itself says the word is a valuation the laws do not make.
findings.where: /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/results/atlas/families/c.md (closed-capture, Beyond its couplings); /Users/ren/theories/README.md first screen; site-wide count 1,294

findings.what: 'Degeneration (退化)' is a valenced synonym for a term the grammar already names neutrally, and it is in the title of the map chapter.
findings.quote: title "Generation, keeping and degeneration"; "degeneration (退化, tuìhuà) is 尽"; "Read at one class, turnover that sustains a pattern and turnover that ends it look alike"
findings.why_it_matters: Poles: generative against degenerate, generation favoured. The definition is 'ends on every branch', and chapter 1 has the four marks 生住异亡, "none standing alone". The glossary then needs three negations to stop 'generation' being read as good ("never means arising, nor any new organization, and it is not 生生"). Ren's words of 8 November: "arise, generate, continue, die, the cycle of life ... there is nothing right or wrong about it".

findings.what: The ethics is still stated on the first screen as an order that ranks, built on a self and a step to others.
findings.where: /Users/ren/theories/README.md ("How far it has been seen", "Its ethics"); /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md ("The ethics"); /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md (§4 head "How far concern reaches, and how it ranks courses"; 'rank' 240 times, 'self-concern' 106)
findings.quote: "call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks one course above another whenever the one keeps all the other keeps and adds to the life's own continuation"; "its own concern need not count them: counting them is the one step we offer"
findings.why_it_matters: Two pairs: higher against lower (ranking), and self against other with a step across. Ren, 8 November: "it doesn't need to be ranking/comparison", "'account', 'ranking' are probably not the right framing", "the interconnected 'self' and environment - which has never been two". The proved content can be said without either pair: whether what a course draws down comes round to what the life lives on; what every way of counting everything agrees on. The Lean keeps its orders; the front does not have to lead with them.

findings.what: The home page's body is the opening of 10 October, the author's first-person text from before his turn of 8 November, patched in place. It holds the strongest dualisms on the public face.
findings.quote: "it draws a line exactly, though I no longer call it the line between good and evil"; "the case lies on one side of this line"; "These are the dynamics of cancer" ('cancer' 16 times in README); "We need to stop seeing each other as enemies"; "the logic of winning"; "What is worse"; "toward a good future"; "Follow the truth."

Health against disease, winners against the rest, truth against "incoherent narratives" stand on the page the site's home is built from, above a first screen that says there is no good and evil. Ren said on 8 November "many of my own early words and assumption, should be adjusted". No session may rewrite his voice, so this stays until he decides. The atlas already has the neutral name for the cancer case: "A confined rise within a whole".

findings.what: 'People and AI' is repeated as a formula, and 'AI within it' is appended to 生生, which marks AI as outside by default.
findings.where: /Users/ren/theories/README.md, ONE-PAGE.md, USES.md, GLOSSARY.md (88 such pairs across the site pages; USES has a field headed "People and AI together")
findings.quote: "right and wrong form within it, in people and AI"; "for life, 生生, AI within it"; "any mind, human or machine"

findings.what: 'Blind', 'drain', 'capture', 'stagnation' are used as names although the glossary bans a milder sibling and a neutral own word exists for each.
findings.quote: glossary: "couples into ... (never 'registers')"; "reach (及): the transitive closure of a relation"; "margin, draw, giving"; entry name: "Selection blind beyond the coupling closure"
findings.why_it_matters: Sight against blindness, full against drained, free against captured, growing against stagnant. The work's own words (reach, draw, a rule read from the share it selects, rest) say the same laws with no pole. Using the field's word once as a labelled alias ("what economics calls lock-in") keeps recognisability without making it the name.

findings.what: 'Exit' has two senses on the public face: in the atlas any leaving of a dynamic; on the uses page a way out of a failure.
findings.quote: USES: "The questions above say where a selection can fail to read and lock. These are ... Exits"; TERRAIN: "Nothing here ranks courses or says where a course should go."
findings.why_it_matters: On the page a practitioner reads, the map is explicitly traps and escapes. That is a legitimate use (it is what we want), but it is the want speaking under the map's word, and it contradicts the atlas's own caption.

findings.what: Pairs that do honest work and should stay.
findings.quote: "Going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other"; "reaches only what couples into it"; "within what a renewal gives"; "frozen before scoring"; "proved, tested, argued, a reading, or wanted"
findings.why_it_matters: Goes on/ends (延/尽) is a proved exclusion, and ending is one of the four marks, not a failure. Reads/does not reach is the content of the selection theorem; it is a boundary relative to a named selector. Within/beyond a renewal is a threshold. Widens/keeps the same/mixed is a three-way relation between two courses, honest until it is glossed as better. Pass/fail belongs to a test that could fail. 'How far seen' is graded, not two-valued. Point of no return is an asymmetry in the dynamics, not a valuation. Removing these would remove what the theory says.

demonstration:
EIGHT FAMILIES, RE-SAID BY DYNAMICS

A. "Absorption and ending" -> "Ending and no return (尽 · 不返)". Ending stays, because it is one of the four marks and not a failure; what the family is about is the point past which a course does not come back.

B. "Drains beyond what couples in" -> "Drawing where the reading does not reach (取于所不及)". 'Drain' judged the result; 'draw' and 'reach' are the work's own words for the two relations the family holds: a draw against a renewal, and what a selection answers to.

C. "Capture of the selection" -> "A rule formed from what it selects". 'Capture' supposes a captor and a free state before; the dynamic is a rule rebuilt from its own results, which is also how a shared code forms (the family's own entry).

D. "Locks of knowing" -> "A reading and the course it chooses". The lock is one regime of the loop of predicting, choosing and revising, not its name; the same loop is learning.

E. "Waiting and reciprocity" -> "Giving that waits on giving". Only the abstract nouns go; the entry's own words already name the dynamic.

F. "Cycles and alternation" -> "Return and turning (复 · 反)". Adds that this is where a course reverses, under the condition the laws give (a step that overshoots), so 物极必反 has a home with its premise.

G. "Closure and stagnation" -> "Rest, and what keeps arising (止 · 生)". 'Stagnation' judged rest against growth; the laws here say when change stops, that ceasing and arising pace each other, and what continued arising needs from outside.

H. "Kept regions, renewal, generation" -> "Going on through turnover (传)". It stops being the one favoured family: it names how anything persists while its parts change, under which a forest, a habit and a monopoly are alike, each then asked what it draws on and closes.

FIVE CENTRAL CONCEPTS, RE-SAID

1. Lock / closed capture / meta-attractor. "A rule that is rebuilt from what it selects holds its course: nothing it does not read can turn it. The same loop gives a language, a habit, a currency and a monopoly; they differ in what the loop draws on outside what it reads, and who bears that." Changed: lock and kept region are said as one dynamic, and 'loss' becomes what is drawn on outside the reading.

2. Drain / "a selection drains beyond what it reads". "A selection answers only to what reaches it. Pushed as far as it can go on what reaches it, it takes whatever of the rest can be turned into that, down to the least any outcome leaves." Changed: no 'loss', 'drain' or 'blind'; reach and conversion are stated, and who depends on the rest is a separate question.

3. Generation, keeping, degeneration. "A pattern goes on in two ways: carried across the turnover of its parts (传), or held with none (守). Or it ends on every branch (尽). The parts' ending is how the carried pattern goes on: a fed fire and a dying one both burn their fuel." Changed: 'degeneration' gives way to the grammar's own 'ends', and the unity of ending at one grain with going on at another is said in the definition.

4. Widening and narrowing (and C). "Two courses can differ in what can still form. One may keep all the other keeps and more: that difference every way of counting everything agrees on. Or each keeps something the other ends: that difference no law weighs." Changed: no 'better', 'ranks above' or 'more future' as praise; it is a difference between two courses, with who agrees on it.

5. Self-concern, the one step, whose losses count. "A life goes on through what sustains it. Where what its course draws down comes round to what it lives on, attending to its own going on already takes that in. Where it does not come round, as with the mussel bed, nothing in its own going on brings it into view; whether it is seen depends on who else is coupled to it and on what the life comes to read. What we offer is that reading." Changed: self against other and the step across become one relation (comes round or does not), and ranking becomes seeing; the proved limit (one-way relations force nothing) stays in the sentence.
where_ren_may_be_wrong_or_incomplete:
1. Not every pair is a dualism, and a naive purge would cost the theory its content. Goes on/ends is a proved exclusion; reads/does not reach is the selection theorem; the point of no return is an asymmetry in the dynamics; a frozen test must be able to fail. 物极必反 is conditional in the work's own laws (a step that keeps the order does not reverse; some ends do not return). A map painted as everything turning into its opposite would say more than is there.

2. The want is asymmetric, and it is his. AGENTS.md says "keeps humans and AI ... out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor". A map drawn for that purpose will draw drawing-down and self-reading rules in more detail than forests. That is not dualism if it is said as a want within becoming; it becomes dualism when the want is hidden in the map's names. So the fix is to separate layers, not to pretend the map has no purpose.

3. Much of the adverse vocabulary is his own: drain, lock, capture, meta-attractor, cancer, the logic of winning, the truth. The home page's densest dualism is his opening, which sessions were right not to rewrite. Part of what he read as 'heavily dualistic' is his text of 10 October, and only he can move or revise it.

4. His two complaints pull against each other. Neutral names by dynamics are less recognisable than 'lock-in', 'capture', 'commons', and 文言 terms add to 'our vocabulary'. Plain English verbs first, the field's word once as a labelled alias, and the 文言 as a second signifier is the trade I would make; it will not satisfy both fully.

5. He approved, on 9 November (message 12), the reading that the ethics emerges where relations close and that counting dependents where they run one way is 'the step offered'. The self/other and two-halves structure on the fronts follows from that approval. If he now finds it dual, the reading itself needs his second look, not only its wording.

6. Renaming is cheap and visible, and it may be judged again as cosmetic. The structural change (regimes of one relation, the four questions asked of every entry) is where the dualism actually sits, and it is weeks of reading across 183 entries, not a wording pass.
could_not_judge: I did not read the Chinese editions, so I cannot say whether the .zh pages carry the same poles or fewer (the families have no Chinese names in vocabulary.json). I read chapters 02 and 07 only at their openings and headings, and did not read the bodies of 01, 03 to 06 or 08, the crosswalk, PREMISES, JOINS, map.html, LINEAGE, TESTS or RESULTS for this lens. I did not open the rendered site. That locks, absorbing regions and kept regions are one invariant-region law is taken from the atlas plan's own definitions and a session note citing `Invariant.reach`; I did not check it in the Lean. Word counts are by regular expression over the 60 allow-listed pages plus README.md and include formal uses (for example 'rank' inside Lean names), so they show weight, not a count of dualistic uses.
